fixture.cover_semantics: Collision-only boxes block paid Spray rays; they are not opaque building/hex-pillar LOS surfaces. Target and cell POV visibility is recorded, not inferred from shot cover.

limitations: Scripted local scenario, not physical input, human visual acceptance, natural Wellspring pillar artwork, multiplayer, capacity, performance, full-roster or all-element acceptance. Whole-cell selection clips center rays; it does not stencil partial hexes. Diagnostic shot-cover boxes do not establish opaque POV occlusion. No injected spells, fields, or deposits.

paid_cast.material_evidence: Actual post-step committed cast footprint, source ownership, one ground part, 600 ground and zero flight; private terminal events are consumed by SimWorld.

runtime_identity.authority: Generated from canonical production runtime source records; delivery, publication and acceptance remain separate.

scope: One real paid SimCommand Water Spray in production Bootstrap's diagnostic HexCourtPractice, two fixture collision boxes, three real hostile champion profiles. Four unscaled full native frames: pulse and paid active aftermath, each Normal/Reduced at identical authority hashes. Production collision debug overlay exposes fixture geometry; cached production five-spoke geometry and all candidate/selected cell visibility are recorded.
